papers.title: IMPACT RESISTANCE OF LATTICE STRUCTURE MADE BY SELECTIVE LASER MELTING FROM AlSi12 ALLOY
papers.abstract: Rolling bearings are an important part of most machines with rotating parts.Therefore, their technical diagnostics is an essential condition for ensuring the safe operation of the machine.This article focuses on the assessment of the condition of bearings using one of the methods of technical diagnosticsvibration diagnostics.In our case it is determination of the value of diagnostic variables of rolling bearings with a subsequent prediction of their condition based on the evaluation of time series analysis.Theoretical knowledge and practices are verified based on measurement data obtained from single-row ball bearings of type 3208A in the manufacturer test room.

summary_en.motivation: Rolling bearing diagnostics are essential for safe operation of rotating machinery.
summary_en.method: The condition of bearings is assessed using vibration diagnostics and time series analysis.
summary_en.result: The diagnostic method was verified using measurement data from single-row ball bearings.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements from manufacturer test room.

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the effectiveness of integrating active learning into an integrated medical science course over five years.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of student performance and feedback from a redesigned curriculum incorporating active learning strategies.
summary_en.result: Active learning integration led to improved student engagement and academic outcomes.
summary_en.validation: Validation based on course grades and student surveys.
